# ciphertrust_azure_secret_list (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve a list of Azure secrets known to CipherTrust Manager. Supply a `filters` map to narrow the results. Each secret version is a separate entry, so use the `version` filter with the value `-1` to return only the latest version of each secret. The secret value is never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Notes
# - Each secret version is a separate entry. Use the version filter with the value
#   "-1" to return only the latest version of each secret.
# - The default limit is 10. Use limit = "-1" to return all matches.
# - All filter values must be strings, for example "true" rather than true.
# - The secret value is never returned.

# List secrets (first 10 by default)
data "ciphertrust_azure_secret_list" "all" {}

# List all secrets, latest version only
data "ciphertrust_azure_secret_list" "latest" {
  filters = {
    version = "-1"
    limit   = "-1"
  }
}

# List the secrets of a vault by vault name
data "ciphertrust_azure_secret_list" "by_vault_name" {
  filters = {
    key_vault = "my-key-vault"
    version   = "-1"
  }
}

# List the secrets of a vault by CipherTrust Manager vault ID, newest first
data "ciphertrust_azure_secret_list" "by_vault_id" {
  filters = {
    key_vault_id = ciphertrust_azure_vault.vault.id
    version      = "-1"
    sort         = "-createdAt"
  }
}

# Find a secret by name
data "ciphertrust_azure_secret_list" "by_name" {
  filters = {
    secret_name = "my-secret"
    version     = "-1"
  }
}

# List the latest version of each enabled secret
data "ciphertrust_azure_secret_list" "enabled_latest" {
  filters = {
    enabled = "true"
    version = "-1"
  }
}

# List secrets in a region
data "ciphertrust_azure_secret_list" "by_region" {
  filters = {
    region  = "eastus"
    version = "-1"
  }
}

# List secrets that have been deleted in Azure
data "ciphertrust_azure_secret_list" "deleted_in_azure" {
  filters = {
    deleted_in_azure = "true"
  }
}

# Find a secret by the Azure identifier of one version
data "ciphertrust_azure_secret_list" "by_secret_id" {
  filters = {
    secret_id = "https://my-key-vault.vault.azure.net/secrets/my-secret/0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
  }
}

# Find the versions of a secret by backup.
# All versions of a secret share the same backup. A new backup is made each time
# a version is created, so use the backup of the latest version.
data "ciphertrust_azure_secret_list" "by_backup" {
  filters = {
    backup = ciphertrust_azure_secret.latest.backup
  }
}

# List secrets whose tags contain a JSON value
data "ciphertrust_azure_secret_list" "by_tags" {
  filters = {
    tags    = jsonencode({ environment = "test" })
    version = "-1"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) A map of key/value pairs matching CipherTrust Manager API query parameters for listing Azure secrets.

> **Note:** Although some filters represent integers or booleans, all filter values must be specified as strings. For example, use `"-1"` rather than `-1`.

| filter           | type    | description |
|------------------|---------|-------------|
| skip             | integer | Index of the first result to return (default: 0). |
| limit            | integer | Maximum number of results to return (default: 10). Use `"-1"` to return all matches. |
| sort             | string  | Fields to sort by. Prefix with `-` for descending order (for example, `-createdAt`). |
| id               | string  | Filter by CipherTrust Manager resource ID. |
| key_vault        | string  | Filter by key vault name. |
| key_vault_id     | string  | Filter by CipherTrust Manager vault resource ID. |
| secret_name      | string  | Filter by Azure secret name. |
| region           | string  | Filter by region. |
| status           | string  | Filter by secret status. |
| backup           | string  | Filter by backup. |
| enabled          | boolean | Filter by the enabled attribute. |
| deleted_in_azure | boolean | Filter by whether the secret has been deleted in Azure. |
| secret_id        | string  | Filter by Azure secret identifier. |
| gone             | boolean | Filter by gone. |
| version          | string  | Filter by version. Use `"-1"` to return only the latest version of each secret. |
| tags             | string  | A valid JSON value. Secrets whose tags contain the JSON value are returned. |
| managed          | boolean | Filter by whether the secret is managed by CipherTrust Manager. |

### Read-Only

- `matched` (Number) Total number of secrets that match the filters. It can be larger than the number returned when limit is used.
- `secrets` (Attributes List) The secrets that match the filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--secrets))

<a id="nestedatt--secrets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `secrets`

Read-Only:

- `azure_created_at` (String) Time the secret was created in Azure.
- `azure_updated_at` (String) Time the secret was last updated in Azure.
- `backup` (String) Backup of the secret.
- `backup_at` (String) Time the secret was backed up.
- `cloud_name` (String) Azure cloud the secret belongs to.
- `content_type` (String) Content type of the secret.
- `created_at` (String) Time the secret was created in CipherTrust Manager.
- `deleted` (Boolean) Whether the secret is deleted.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the secret is enabled.
- `gone` (Boolean) Whether the secret is gone from Azure.
- `id` (String) CipherTrust Manager resource ID of the secret.
- `name` (String) Name of the secret in Azure.
- `recoverable_days` (Number) Days a deleted secret can be recovered.
- `recovery_level` (String) Recovery level of the secret.
- `region` (String) Azure region of the key vault.
- `secret_id` (String) Azure secret identifier.
- `secret_soft_deleted_in_azure` (Boolean) Whether the secret is soft-deleted in Azure.
- `soft_delete_enabled` (Boolean) Whether soft delete is enabled on the key vault.
- `status` (String) Status of the secret.
- `synced_at` (String) Time the secret was last synchronized.
- `tags` (String) Tags of the secret as a JSON string.
- `tenant` (String) Azure tenant ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Time the secret was last updated in CipherTrust Manager.
- `vault_id` (String) CipherTrust Manager resource ID of the vault that holds the secret.
- `vault_name` (String) Name of the Azure vault that contains the secret.
- `version` (String) Version of the secret.
- `version_count` (Number) Number of versions of the secret.
